items.title: James Moody — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: So, he was like the manager, so he -- his father sent him on the road with us.

ctx.x: Billy Shaw, right. So Milt liked -- he liked Dizzy very much because he played trumpet. So, he was like the manager, so he -- his father sent him on the road with us. Me and Milt were the same age. All right? So we got -- when we got down South, I wanted a bath so bad, man, you know, and wanted to go, so I said, "Hey, Milt." I said, "You do me a favor?" He says, "Yeah, what?" I said, "Man, let me carry your bags and pretend like I'm your valet and let me 'cause I wanna get a bath, and I wanna go." He says, "Okay."
